command: ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIAL=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell input keyevent 4; sleep 1; echo '--- after one Back ---'; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys input_method | grep -E 'mInputShown|mIsInputViewShown' | head -10 || true; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json >/dev/null
